name: Many unrelated depositors paying into one account
description: Numerous unconnected individuals make deposits into the same account, often in similar amounts or within short windows.
fp: Collections for clubs, charities, landlords or crowdfunding can legitimately attract many depositors.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering through the Physical Transportation of Cash (2015)
FFIEC, BSA/AML Examination Manual (FinCEN is not publisher)
FATF, Money Laundering Typologies and Methods (general placement guidance)
FinCEN, Guidance on structuring and Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) reporting (general)
AUSTRAC, Guidance on structuring and threshold transaction reports (general)

links.name: Multiple unrelated depositors to same account
links.ctx: Numerous third parties deposit into one account, sometimes with slips or reference.

links.name: Multiple depositors paying into one account
links.ctx: Several unrelated individuals make cash deposits into the same account, often in similar amounts and at similar times.
links.fp: Collections for clubs, rent, fundraising or family contributions may fit.
